symbols.name: Second unpacker
symbols.detail: Entry of the unpacker copied into $00E8–$01E7, executing inside the stack page; entry point.

symbols.name: Relocated unpacker
symbols.detail: Runs the relocated unpacker, which also copies a table to $0723 over the bootstrap; entry point.

symbols.name: Relocate loader payload
symbols.detail: Copies 199 pages from $3901 to $0801 (routine copied from $2D07–$2D1D).

symbols.name: Copy unpacker to stack page
symbols.detail: Copies another unpacker into $00E8–$01E7 and enters it at $0100; entry point.

symbols.name: Bootstrap copy to $0340
symbols.detail: Copies 256 bytes from $4131 to $0340, then jumps there.

symbols.name: Terrain strip pointer advance
symbols.detail: INC $47F8 advances the first terrain strip sprite pointer (single instruction site).

symbols.name: Keyboard scan
symbols.detail: Tests a table of column and row masks; the 8 key makes it write slot 7 to $05C0; entry point.

symbols.name: Level update entry
symbols.detail: Level-update routine entry used as the player logic boundary; entry point.

symbols.name: End-of-level path
symbols.detail: Address where the player reads the level result once the end flag ($0588 bit 7) is set.

symbols.name: Decrement timer
symbols.detail: Decrements the level timer copied to $CB39–$CB3B; entry point.

symbols.name: Documentation page Space wait
symbols.detail: Waits for SPACE on each of three documentation pages; entry point.

symbols.name: Level setup
symbols.detail: Engine setup that copies ten header pointers into instruction operands and working tables; entry point.

symbols.name: Initialize release interval
symbols.detail: Initializes $0578 from the release-interval table index $E03C (source address).

symbols.name: Copy skill-stock tens
symbols.detail: Copies $E044–$E04B to the tens array at $05C8–$05CF (source address).

symbols.name: Copy skill-stock units
symbols.detail: Copies $E04C–$E053 to the units array at $05D2–$05D9 (source address).

symbols.name: Copy level time
symbols.detail: Copies the time digits $E041–$E043 to $CB39–$CB3B (source address).

symbols.name: Patch exit tests
symbols.detail: Patches the exit tests at $1F80 from the header exit records; entry point.

symbols.name: Click dispatcher
symbols.detail: Checks the pending click, targeted lemming, selected slot and stock, then looks up the slot handler at $15BA/$15C2.

symbols.name: Render two decimal digits
symbols.detail: Renders a skill stock as two decimal digits; entry point.

symbols.name: Digger assignment
symbols.detail: Slot 7 handler that rejects unsuitable modes and otherwise assigns digging mode 6.

symbols.name: Cursor control entry
symbols.detail: Input entry where cursor controls are applied for each numbered cursor-control call; entry point.

symbols.name: Cursor bottom clamp
symbols.detail: Loads 167 and writes it to cursor Y at $B8 after an update exceeds the bottom boundary.

symbols.name: Vertical cursor clamp
symbols.detail: Clamps vertical cursor movement (with $17E8) (source address).

symbols.name: Horizontal cursor clamp ($185D)
symbols.detail: Clamps horizontal cursor movement (with $18B8) (source address).

symbols.name: Horizontal cursor clamp ($18B8)
symbols.detail: Clamps horizontal cursor movement (with $185D) (source address).

symbols.name: Lemming release routine
symbols.detail: Adds a table-selected increment to an accumulator and, on carry, releases a lemming from an enabled entrance; returns at $1E69.

symbols.name: Select release increment
symbols.detail: Uses the release-interval index to select the release increment (source address).

symbols.name: Release count cap
symbols.detail: Stops releases when the released count reaches the header lemming count $E039.

symbols.name: Entrance record selection
symbols.detail: Selects and uses the header entrance records to place a new lemming.

symbols.name: Spawn X offset
symbols.detail: Adds 2 to the entrance X for a new lemming (source address).

symbols.name: Spawn Y offset
symbols.detail: Adds 5 to the entrance Y for a new lemming (source address).

symbols.name: Exit tests
symbols.detail: Exit tests patched by $1351 from the header exit records (source address).

symbols.name: Release intro entry
symbols.detail: Enters the release intro (continuing at $2C16), clears the screen and runs fades; entry point.

symbols.name: Release intro raster IRQ ($23B4)
symbols.detail: Nested raster interrupt handler that maintains the release intro; entry point.

symbols.name: Release intro raster IRQ ($23F0)
symbols.detail: Nested raster interrupt handler that maintains the release intro; entry point.

symbols.name: Digger handler
symbols.detail: Mode 6 handler that clears the animation frame terrain points and returns a movement index.

symbols.name: Patch terrain reader operands
symbols.detail: Patches the terrain reader operands for the current lemming; entry point.

symbols.name: Terrain reader
symbols.detail: Combines horizontal and vertical table entries to locate a byte and mask one of its four two-bit pairs.

symbols.name: Alternate terrain classifier
symbols.detail: Helper that additionally turns pair 3 into an empty result for its callers.

symbols.name: Clear terrain pair
symbols.detail: Clears a two-bit pair in the world bitmap and, for a visible column, the display bitmap; entry point.

symbols.name: Skip empty-pair stores
symbols.detail: Skips both stores when the world pair is already empty, preserving composited display graphics.

symbols.name: Patch object loop limit
symbols.detail: Patches the object-table loop limit at $2B1C from header byte $E07B (source address).

symbols.name: Object-table loop limit
symbols.detail: Object-table loop limit test patched by $2A54 (source address).

symbols.name: Release intro (from $2300)
symbols.detail: Reached from $2300 to clear the screen and run the release intro fades; entry point.

symbols.name: Release intro Space poll
symbols.detail: Polls SPACE; the scripted input continues through the original exit branch; entry point.

symbols.name: Release intro exit
symbols.detail: Release exit branch, after which the $0405 relocation annotation is enabled (source address).

symbols.name: Joystick fire read
symbols.detail: LDA $DC00 / AND #$10 read of the fire bit where the level scenario supplies its fire press.

symbols.name: First trainer prompt
symbols.detail: First of twelve trainer prompts that call KERNAL GETIN and compare the result with Y/N; entry point.

symbols.name: Menu input loop
symbols.detail: Game menu input loop reached after the menu loads; entry point.

symbols.name: Menu GETIN result test
symbols.detail: Tests the GETIN result; character 1 takes the one-player branch (single instruction site).

symbols.name: Restore normal display
symbols.detail: Restores the normal display before entering the next loader stage; entry point.

symbols.name: Derive selected level code
symbols.detail: Derives the selected level code; entry point.

symbols.name: Start compressed file
symbols.detail: Disk request (LDX #8, JSR $FFBA, LDA #8) where the two-letter file stream is selected.

symbols.name: Read compressed block headers
symbols.detail: Reads compressed block headers before expanding the selected disk stream; entry point.

symbols.name: Finish compressed file
symbols.detail: Loader exit where the stream must be fully consumed before returning (source address).

symbols.name: Compressed stream decoder
symbols.detail: Expands the selected disk stream, writing output backward from the destination end; entry point.

symbols.name: Overlapping BIT/PLA refill
symbols.detail: Refill path BIT $68 / PLA / RTS; the end-of-stream branch enters at $CF05 to execute the operand byte as PLA.

symbols.name: Disk byte receiver
symbols.detail: Original receiver boundary where bytes from the pinned disk file are supplied; entry point.

symbols.name: Trainer-aware stock decrement
symbols.detail: Checks the trainer bit in $CFFC, borrows a ten when units are zero, then subtracts one use; entry point.

symbols.name: Level file rearrangement decoder
symbols.detail: Performs another expansion and rearrangement of the decoded level file; entry point.

symbols.name: KERNAL video timing tail
symbols.detail: Documented KERNAL video timing tail entered by the menu display restoration; entry point.
